Hendley & Co Lifted Position in Monsanto Company (MON) as Share Value Rose; Peapack Gladstone Financial Has Trimmed Its Position in Eaton Plc (ETN) by $12.01 Million
May 15, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Peapack Gladstone Financial Corp decreased its stake in Eaton Corp Plc (ETN) by 2.48% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Peapack Gladstone Financial Corp sold 152 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.84% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 5,984 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $472.80 million, down from 6,136 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Peapack Gladstone Financial Corp who had been investing in Eaton Corp Plc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $33.31B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.55% or $0.42 during the last trading session, reaching $76.16. About 660,193 shares traded. Eaton Corporation plc (NYSE:ETN) has risen 9.67% since May 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 1.88% the S&P500.
Hendley & Co Inc increased its stake in Monsanto Company (MON) by 9.54% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hendley & Co Inc bought 2,844 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.12% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 32,656 shares of the agricultural chemicals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.81 million, up from 29,812 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hendley & Co Inc who had been investing in Monsanto Company for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $55.17B market cap company. The stock increased 0.05% or $0.06 during the last trading session, reaching $125.01. About 674,485 shares traded. Monsanto Company (NYSE:MON) has risen 3.06% since May 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.49% the S&P500.
Peapack Gladstone Financial Corp, which manages about $1862.93B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Inc (NASDAQ:REGN) by 22 shares to 1,012 shares, valued at $380.47M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2,178 shares in the quarter, for a total of 236,035 shares, and has risen its stake in Alphabet Inc Cl C.
